root_text:
⚠️ HEALTH ALERT ⚠️

Reports of a new virus outbreak in China have been circulating over the past week. The Indian government has confirmed two cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Karnataka today.

Source: https://t.co/TFRrhm0CK3
